bar_provider.label: Provider in the bar
bar_provider.description: Source the bar shows: claude, grok, codex, agy, cursor, opencode or claude:<account name>. Middle click on the widget cycles through the sources; changing this setting overrides that choice.

claude_user_agent.label: Claude User-Agent
claude_user_agent.description: Must look like a published Claude Code CLI or the endpoint rate-limits.

claude_accounts.label: Frozen Claude accounts
claude_accounts.description: One Name=dir per entry. The panel shows their last status. Example: Frozen=~/.claude-freeze
